commentary.headline: October 2026 financial performance was negatively impacted by an unbudgeted marketing event spend alongside ongoing price cuts on Summit Jacket and sales volume shortfalls in the West region.

paragraphs.text: Marketing Events expense at vendor Brightline Events generated an unfavorable variance of -$84,986.45, with actual spend reaching $91,538.45 against a budget of $6,552.00. This variance was driven by a sudden surge in spend in October 2026 after monthly costs consistently tracked near budgeted levels between $5,927.53 and $6,636.50 over the previous two years.

Summit Jacket produced an unfavorable price variance of -$26,215.20 across 993 units sold in October 2026. The variance stemmed from an average realized price of $193.60 compared to the budgeted $220.00, continuing a 12% price reduction that began in September 2026.

The West region generated an unfavorable volume variance of -$31,130.00 as total unit sales reached 786 units against a budget of 992 units. This shortfall of 206 units affected all three product lines and represents a continuation of regional volume declines that began in September 2026.
